_comment: Task types. weight = how often the spawner picks it. timeLimit and hold are seconds. calm = anger removed on success; angerOnFail = anger added if the timer runs out. membership: legitChance = share of valid cards; angerOnWrong = anger for a wrong call. trouble = troublemakers (dive-bombing, running by the pool, the stag do in the bowling alley, a chip fight in the cafe, Gains Gary dropping weights). spill = puddles, sick and litter. pins = a bowling lane's pinsetter jammed. treadmill = broken gym kit. lifeguard = Gaz has dozed off. vending = the machine has eaten Little Alfie's pound (thumping it calms Andy). complaint and phone: fobbing someone off removes brushOffCalm anger, sorting it adds ticketAnger; every brushOffsBeforeManager fob-offs in a day, the Area Manager turns up; hanging up on a cold call removes hangUpCalm, hearing them out adds hearOutAnger. toilet: garyChance = how often Gains Gary is the culprit. manager = meeting with the Area Manager in the office.
